name: William Mortimer
description: GeoCart 2016 lists Mortimer as the presenter of a paper on GEOINT New Zealand military topographic mapping.
story: The GeoCart 2016 programme lists William Mortimer as presenter of a paper on GEOINT New Zealand’s 1:50,000 Military Topographic Map Production and gives the New Zealand Defence Force as his affiliation. This records the named conference contribution and affiliation shown in that programme.
